sentences.en: On Tuesday, a federal judge in Manhattan denied an effort by former President Trump to claim immunity in his New York state hush money case, in which he was already convicted.
sentences.zh: 周二，曼哈顿的一名联邦法官驳回了前总统特朗普在其纽约州封口费案中主张豁免权的请求，他此前在该案中已被判有罪。

sentences.en: Earlier this year, a jury had found Trump guilty of covering up payments he made while in office to a porn star who had threatened to go public about an affair.
sentences.zh: 今年早些时候，陪审团裁定特朗普有罪，罪名是他掩盖了自己在任期间向一名威胁要公开绯闻的色情明星支付款项的行为。

sentences.en: Trump invoked a recent Supreme Court ruling granting presidents broad immunity for official acts.
sentences.zh: 特朗普援引了最高法院最近的一项裁决，该裁决赋予总统在官方行为中享有广泛的豁免权。

sentences.en: But the judge said that ruling was irrelevant in this case.
sentences.zh: 但法官表示，该裁决在本案中并不适用。

sentences.en: Hush money payments, he said, were private, unofficial acts outside the bounds of executive authority.
sentences.zh: 他说，支付封口费是私人且非官方的行为，超出了行政权力的范围。

sentences.en: The sentencing in this case is scheduled for mid-September, less than seven weeks before Election Day.
